missing_projection.name: issue.subject
missing_projection.expected_by: issue.expected_by_template + qualifier.expected_by_suffix in canonical qualifier order
missing_projection.impact: derived requested impact in canonical stage order

uncertainty_projection.description: fixed description_template; append `涉及“{subject}”。` only when subject exists
uncertainty_projection.impact: all requested stages in canonical order

evidence_projection.ordering: path, signal catalog order, rendered observation

recommendation_projection.output: catalog code + rendered message_template; append qualifier recommendation_suffix in canonical qualifier order

projection_rules.summary_projection: Use frozen deriveAssessmentSummary v1.1 after projected missing/uncertainty; no model summary.
projection_rules.warnings_projection: Use frozen deriveTrustedWarnings; manifest warning only from trusted context.

semantic_validation: Canonical decision JSON must be <=64KiB; full assembled output must pass existing full schema and capacities.
All objects reject unknown fields; normalized duplicate arrays/objects fail closed.
All paths must be manifest-known; typed evidence paths must be manifest files except trusted truncation claim at `.`.
Every claim must be compatible with its containing issue; every qualifier must satisfy issue and required-claim matrix.
No issue may derive an empty impact for trusted requested stages.
source_visibility must satisfy the static-impact matrix.
Sensitive, credential-bearing URI, internal absolute path and source excerpt protections remain unchanged.
Incomplete/uncertain contain no model-provided impact, recommendation, fix, global evidence, dependency array or sandbox field.
Complete validation remains v1.1: positive closure evidence, no material truncation, first-party dependency closure, capability catalog and sandbox consistency.
Parent independently reruns schema, catalog, trusted-context, sensitive and full-output validation.
